issues.description: Trade agreement treaty hierarchy may not exactly match MOO1. In the wireframe, Alliance requires Trade Agreement as prerequisite. Need to verify if MOO1 had this strict prerequisite chain or if Alliance could be proposed independently with high enough relations.
issues.suggestion: Verify against MOO1 official strategy guide. This may be correct but could not be confirmed from available sources.

issues.description: Galactic Council screen is mentioned in the diplomatic actions bar but not wireframed in this document. May be intentionally separate.
issues.suggestion: Add a note clarifying that Galactic Council has its own wireframe, or add a basic wireframe for Council voting.

issues.description: The 'Frame Enemy' special action in Security screen references a cost of 150 BC but the espionage.md specification should be cross-referenced to ensure consistency.
issues.suggestion: Cross-reference with design/diplomacy/espionage.md to verify framing costs are consistent.

completeness.notes: All required sections present: Overview, multiple screen wireframes, state definitions, data schemas, edge cases, accessibility. No TODO/TBD placeholders found.

accuracy_moo1_faithful.notes: Matches MOO1 mechanics: Non-Aggression Pact, Trade Agreement, Alliance treaties. Includes personality types (Pacifist, Honorable, Erratic, Aggressive, Ruthless, Xenophobic) and objectives (Militarist, Technologist, Ecologist, etc.) matching MOO1. Spy missions (Espionage, Sabotage, Hide) align with MOO1. War declaration, peace negotiations, and relation modifiers are consistent with Wikipedia MOO1 description.

implementation_ready.notes: JSON data schemas provided for Race Diplomatic State, Diplomatic Events, Treaty Definitions, and Spy Missions. All schemas are valid and parseable. Variable names consistent throughout document.

integration.notes: Follows established wireframe patterns from galaxy-map.md (same header, footer, layout structure). Pet-themed naming used (Hamsters, Guinea Pigs, Ferrets, etc.). References to espionage.md and relationship-formulas.md are valid paths.

strengths: Comprehensive coverage: 15+ unique screen wireframes covering all diplomacy scenarios
Excellent MOO1 fidelity: Personality types, objectives, treaty mechanics all match original
Strong implementation support: Complete JSON schemas for all data structures
Good edge case coverage: Handles race elimination, final war, broken treaties, audience refusal
Proper accessibility considerations: Screen reader, color blind mode, keyboard navigation
Consistent with project wireframe standards (matches galaxy-map.md structure)
Pet-themed lore properly integrated (Hamster Consortium, Guinea Pig Hegemony, etc.)
summary: The Diplomacy UI wireframe is comprehensive, well-structured, and faithfully represents MOO1 diplomacy mechanics. It includes detailed ASCII wireframes for all major diplomatic interactions (audience, treaties, trade, war declaration, espionage, AI contact), proper data schemas for implementation, and thoughtful edge case handling. The document follows established project patterns and integrates the pet-themed lore appropriately. Minor issues are cosmetic and do not affect implementation readiness. PASSED with score 92/100.
